主题：DPO Targets
Target DPO range: 30-45 days.

- Under 30 days: paying too quickly (losing cash float)
- Over 45 days: paying too slowly (risk vendor relationships)
- DPO = Average AP Balance / (Total Purchases / Days in Period)
- Q4 has 92 days

- CFO"}
